title: Private equity firm Epiris agrees to acquire European enterprise comms provider Gamma Communications for ~£1B, a 53% premium to Gamma's share price on April 7 (Shona Ghosh/Bloomberg)
summary: Shona Ghosh / Bloomberg: Private equity firm Epiris agrees to acquire European enterprise comms provider Gamma Communications for ~£1B, a 53% premium to Gamma's share price on April 7 — Private equity firm Epiris has agreed to buy Gamma Communications Plc for about £1 billion ($1.4 billion) …
